item.title: Version 1.0.2
item.description:
Fixes

  • Correct MTC timing — quarter-frames now sent at the spec rate with properly latched sequences, so downstream receivers track smoothly
  • Full-frame cue messages on chase start and timecode jumps (drop-frame aware)
  • Signal-loss watchdog — on LTC dropout the app drops lock and stops MTC output instead of freewheeling stale timecode, and re-cues automatically when signal returns
  • Sample rate follows the input device automatically; the manual picker (which could decode at the wrong speed) is gone
  • Auto-update restored — v1.0.1 shipped without Sparkle keys and could never update itself
  • Start failures now show an error dialog instead of failing silently

New

  • Apple-native UI redesign and the app's first icon
